openwrt_git.betreff: ath79: add support for Enterasys WS-AP3705i
openwrt_git.text:
ath79: add support for Enterasys WS-AP3705i

Hardware
--------
SoC:    Atheros AR9344
RAM:    128M DDR2
FLASH:  2x Macronix MX25L12845EM
        2x 16MiB SPI-NOR
WLAN2:  Atheros AR9344 2x2 2T2R
WLAN5:  Atheros AR9580 2x2 2T2R
SERIAL: Cisco-RJ45 on the back (115200 8n1)

Installation
------------

The U-Boot CLI is password protected (using the same credentials as the
OS). Default is admin/new2day.

1. Download the OpenWrt initramfs-image. Place it into a TFTP server
   root directory and rename it to 1401A8C0.img. Configure the TFTP
   server to listen at 192.168.1.66/24.

2. Connect the TFTP server to the access point.

3. Connect to the serial console of the access point. Attach power and
   interrupt the boot procedure when prompted (bootdelay is 1 second).

4. Configure the U-Boot environment for booting OpenWrt from Ram and
   flash:

   $ setenv boot_openwrt 'setenv bootargs; bootm 0xbf230000'
   $ setenv ramboot_openwrt 'setenv serverip 192.168.1.66;
     tftpboot 0x85000000; bootm'
   $ setenv bootcmd 'run boot_openwrt'
   $ saveenv

5. Load OpenWrt into memory:

   $ run ramboot_openwrt

   Wait for the image to boot.

6. Transfer the OpenWrt sysupgrade image to the device. Write the image
   to flash using sysupgrade:

   $ sysupgrade -n /path/to/openwrt-sysuograde.bin

Signed-off-by: David Bauer <mail@david-bauer.net>

openwrt_git_nvmem.text: Userspace handling is deprecated. Use ath9k LED binding to avoid generic LED usage. (PR #16286)

openwrt_git_ubootenv_fix.betreff: ath79: fix u-boot-env nvmem-layout on enterasys,ws-ap3705i
openwrt_git_ubootenv_fix.text: u-boot-env0 enthaelt eine redundante U-Boot-Umgebung (CRC32 + Flag-Byte), env-size 0x1000. Mit dem bisherigen Layout 'u-boot,env' scheitert der nvmem-Layout-Treiber an der CRC, die MAC-Zelle fuer eth0 entsteht nicht, eth0 bleibt in 'deferred probe pending': 'the device boots with no functioning Ethernet interface at all'. Gegen das offizielle 25.12.5 bestaetigt; nach dem Fix laeuft eth0. Fix: 'u-boot,env-redundant-count', env-size 0x1000.

fcc_handbuch.Overview: indoor locations; four spring clips on the back for flat drop ceiling T-bar rail; mounting brackets optional for walls and protruded drop ceilings; 802.11n AP, supports 802.11a/g/b; round, compact enclosure; four internal antennas
fcc_handbuch.LEDs (Tabelle 1-1): LED 1 AP status (gruen an = normal, gruen blinkend = Selbsttest/Software laden, rot = CPU-/Systemfehler); LED 2 Ethernet (gruen = 100 Mbps, blau = 1 Gbps, aus = kein Link); LED 3 Radio 2 (2.4 GHz) gruen; LED 4 Radio 1 (5 GHz) gruen

fcc_handbuch.Reset Switch: pen tip or nail through the hole (located on the side of the AP); < 5 s: software interrupt/reset; >= 5 s: factory default configuration
fcc_handbuch.Kensington Lock Slot: through the mounting bracket locking tab and the side of the AP, above the rivet
